claim_boundary: Simulation-only, development-informed but pose/nuisance/fingerprint-independent S4b adaptation contract. It adds generic complete-orbit coverage at the full-loop visual bound. No full-loop outcome, real F/T sample, or confirmatory evidence is created by this contract.

development_trigger.allowed_use: choose the generic visual-boundary coverage axis only; S4b remains development data and cannot support a confirmatory claim

observation_prior.claim_boundary: pre-hardware engineering prior; replace ranges with measured bias, Allan/covariance, frame-calibration, and latency distributions

outer_boundary_addition.construction: generic geometry-declared boundary; not copied from a failed full-loop task radius or direction

role_semantics.calibration: temperature, APS and final descriptive metrics only
role_semantics.future_full_loop_test: must be newly generated after S4b model/controller/gates are frozen; development-v2 tasks are permanently ineligible
role_semantics.validation: early stopping and model selection only

five_ring_geometry_dependency.role: code/formula dependency only; no S4 dataset artifact is read
